name: Multipurpose Room

steps.text: Go in by the pillar marked 333, through the double doors with the university’s logo.
The Multipurpose Room is on the 4th floor. After exiting the elevator, turn left.
Walk past the Caucus Room; the Multipurpose Room is at the far end, marked orange on the map.

source: Named by the October 14 craft night on the live site (Student Activity Center Multipurpose Rm., 4th floor); the live site has no directions for it. Steps are the Caucus Room’s (owner, 20 Oct 2026: “Hearing Room and Multipurpose room can use the Caucus room steps, edit the image of the map to show where the rooms are”); the plan’s own label places the room.
